'''Zacar Girard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] of [[House Girard]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and his family's alliance with the [[House of Thul]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. The nephew of [[Heitor Girard|Heitor]], cousin of [[Aitalla Girard|Aitalla]], and [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Raffid Girard|Raffid]], Zacar met a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who became his House's advocate. He was eventually found [[Death/Legends|murdered]] while his advocate hunted [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Corwin]].<ref name="TOR" />
